shortDescription: Add a RavenDB node to an existing cluster

options.name: ca_cert_path
options.description: Path to a CA certificate bundle to verify the server certificate.

options.name: certificate_path
options.description: Path to a client certificate in PEM format (combined certificate and key). Required for secured clusters (HTTPS with client authentication).

options.name: leader_url
options.description: The HTTP/HTTPS URL of the cluster leader the module will contact to add the node.

options.name: tag
options.description: The unique tag for the node (uppercase alphanumeric, 1–4 chars).

options.name: type
options.description: Node type. Use C(Watcher) to add the node as a watcher instead of a full member.

options.name: url
options.description: The HTTP/HTTPS URL of the node being added.
